senses.gloss: शंय , श्ंयु &c. See p. 1054.
शंय mfn., Pāṇ. v, 2, 138.
सं-य m. (fr. 2. सम् and √ यम्, or यत्) a skeleton, L.
सं-य See above.
शन्य्-अष्टक n. N. of wk.
शं—यु See शंयु॑, col. 3.
शंयु॑ mfn. benevolent, beneficent, RV.; TS.
happy, fortunate, Bhaṭṭ.
N. of a son of Bṛhas-pati, TS.; Br.; MBh.
शं—यु-वाक m. a sacred formula containing the words सं॑योः॑ (= next), ĀśvŚr. (cf. Pāṇ. ii, 4, 29, Vārtt. 1, Pat.)
शं—योर्-वाक॑ m. the sacred formula beginning with the words त॑च् छं॑-यो॑र् आ वृणीमहे, Br.; ŚrS.
शं—यो॑स् ind. = शं योस् (see under 2. शम्), VS.
= शं-योर्-वाक॑, Br.; KātyŚr.
शं—य्व्-अ᳙न्त mf(आ)n. ending with the formula शंयो॑स्, Vait.
शंयु॑—धायस् (शंयु॑-), mfn. beneficent, refreshing, TĀr.
सं-याज m.
सं-याजन n. in पत्नी-संय्˚ (q.v.)
सं-˚याज्य᳙ mfn. to be made or allowed to sacrifice (see अ-संय्˚)
सं-˚याज्य᳙ n. joining or sharing in a sacrifice, sacrificing (see अ-याज्य-संय्˚)
सं-˚याज्या॑ (आ), f. N. of the Yājyā and Anuvākyā Mantras (recited in the Sviṣṭa-kṛt ceremony), Br.; ŚrS.

सं-√ यत् Ā. -यतते, to unite (in trans.), meet together, encounter (rarely ‘as friends’, generally ‘as enemies’), contend, engage in contest or strife, quarrel (with संग्रामम्, ‘to begin a combat’), RV.; Br.; ChUp.;
 (P. ˚ति) to unite, join together (trans.), RV. vi, 67, 3.
सं-य॑त् mfn. (in some senses fr. सं-√ यम् below, Pāṇ. vi, 4, 40; Vop. 26, 78) coherent, contiguous, continuous, uninterrupted, RV.; ŚāṅkhŚr.
सं-य॑त् f. an agreement, covenant, stipulation, ŚBr.
a means of joining or uniting, TS.
an appointed place, RV. ix, 56, 15
contest, strife, battle, war (generally found in loc. or comp.), MBh.; Kāv. &c.
सं-य॑त् f. N. of partic. bricks (-त्व n.), TS.
सं-य॑त् See above.
सं-यत्—त्व n.
सं-यतिन् See under सं. √ यम्.
सं-यतिन् mfn. controlling, restraining (the senses), MārkP. (prob. w.r. for सं-यमिन् below)
सं॑-यत्त mfn. (pl.) come into conflict (संग्रामे॑ सों॑-यत्ते, ‘at the outbreak of war’), TS.
prepared, ready, being on one's guard, Mn.; MBh. &c.
सं॑-यत mfn. held together, held in, held fast &c.
self-contained, self-controlled with regard to (loc. instr., or comp.), Gaut.; MBh. &c.
tied together, bound up, fettered, confined, imprisoned, captive, Mn.; MBh. &c.
shut up, closed (opp. to व्य्-आत्त), AV.
kept in order (see comp.)
suppressed, subdued, MBh.
= उद्यत, prepared, ready to (inf.), Hariv.
सं॑-यत m. ‘one who controls himself’, N. of Śiva, MBh.
सं-यात mfn. gone together, proceeded together, approached, come, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
सं-यद् in comp. for सं-यत्.
सं-यद्—वर m. (cf. सम्पद्-वर) ‘chief in battle’, a prince, king, Uṇ. iii, 1.
सं-य॑द्—वसु (˚य॑द्-व्˚), mfn. having continuous wealth, VS.; AitBr.
सं-य॑द्—वसु m. one of the seven rays of the sun, VP., Sch.
सं-यद्—वाम mfn. uniting all that is pleasant or dear, ChUp.
सं-य॑द्—वीर (˚य॑द्-व्˚), mfn. abounding in heroes, RV.
सं-यती n. du. of pr. p. of सम्- √ 5. इ (q.v.)
सं-˚यति f. penance, self-castigation, Kuṭṭanīm.
सं-˚याति m. N. of a son of Nahuṣa, MBh.; BhP.
of a son of Pracinvat (Bahu-gava) and father of Ahaṃ-yāti, ib. (Hariv. सम्पाति).
सांयाति g. काश्य्-आदि.
सं-यन्त्रित mfn. (√ यन्त्र्) fastened with bands, held in, stopped, Śak.
सं-यत—चेतस् mfn. controlled in mind, MW.
सं-यत—प्राण mfn. having the breath suppressed or having the organs restrained, ib.
सं-यत—मानस mfn. (= -चेतस्), ib.
सं-यत—मुख mf(ई)n. (= -वाच्), Mṛcch.
सं-यत—मैथुन mfn. one who abstains from sexual intercourse, MBh.
सं-यत—वत् mfn. self-controlled, self-possessed, Hariv.
सं-यत—वस्त्र mfn. having the dress or clothes fastened or tied together, Bhartṛ.
सं-यत—वाच् mfn. restrained in speech, taciturn, silent, MW.
सं-य˚ताक्ष mfn. having the eyes closed, BhP.
सं-य˚ताञ्जलि mfn. having the hands joined together in entreaty (= बद्धाञ्जलि), MW.
सं-य˚तात्मन् mfn. (= ˚त-चेतस्), Mn. xi, 236
सं-य˚ताहार mfn. temperate in eating, MBh.
सं-य˚तेन्द्रिय mfn. having the senses or passions controlled, ib.
सं-य˚तोपस्कर mfn. having the household utensils kept in order, Yājñ.
सं-˚यतक m. N. of a man, Kathās.
सं-˚यत्वर m. = वाग्-यत or जन्तु-समूह, L.
सं-यन्तव्य mfn. to be restrained or controlled, MBh.
सं-˚यन्तृ mfn. one who restrains or controls, restraining, controlling (also as fut., ‘he will restrain’), ib.
सं-यम m. holding together, restraint, control, (esp.) control of the senses, self-control, Mn.; MBh. &c.
tying up (the hair), Sāh.
binding, fettering, VarBṛS.
closing (of the eyes), MārkP.
concentration of mind (comprising the performance of Dhāraṇā, Dhyāna, and Samādhi, or the last three stages in Yoga), Yogas.; Sarvad.
effort, exertion (आ॑, ‘with great difficulty’), MBh.
suppression i.e. destruction (of the world), Pur.
N. of a son of Dhūmrākṣa (and father of Kṛśāśva), BhP.
सं-याम m. = सं-यम, Pāṇ. iii, 3, 63
सं-यम—धन mfn. rich in self-restraint, MBh.
सं-यम—पुण्य-तीर्थ mfn. having restraint for a holy place of pilgrimage, MBh.
सं-यम—वत् mfn. self-controlled, parsimonious, economical, Kathās.
सं-याम—वत् mfn. self-controlled, Bhaṭṭ.
सं-य˚माग्नि m. the fire of abstinence, Bhag.
सं-य˚माम्भस् n. the flood of water at the end of the world, BhP.
सं-˚यमक mfn. checking, restraining, VahniP.
सं-˚यमन mf(ई)n. id., MBh.; Pur.
bringing to rest, RV.
सं-˚यमन n. the act of curbing or checking or restraining, VP.
self-control, KauṣUp.
binding together, tying up, Vikr.; Sāh.
drawing tight, tightening (reins &c.), Śak.
confinement, fetter, Mṛcch.
Yama's residence (cf. above), Bādar.
सांयमन mfn. (fr. संयमन) relating to restraint or self-control, KauṣUp. (v.l.)
सं-˚यमनी (ई), f. N. of the city or residence of Yama (fabled to be situated on Mount Meru), MBh.; BhP.
सांयमनि m. (fr. id.) patr. of Śala, MBh.
सं-˚यमित mfn. (fr. Caus.) restrained, checked, subdued, Ragh.
bound, confined, fettered, Mṛcch.
clasped (in the arms), held, detained, Gīt.
piously disposed, R.
सं-˚यमित n. subduing (the voice), Mṛcch.
सं-यमि-ता f., self-control, Kād.
सं-यमिन् mfn. who or what restrains or curbs or subdues, W.
one who subdues his passions, self-controlled (˚मि-ता f. self-control, Kād.), Hcat.
tied up (as hair), Bhartṛ.
सं-यमिन् m. a ruler, Divyāv.
an ascetic, saint, Ṛṣi, L.
संयमि-नाम-मालिका f. N. of wk. (containing synonyms of names of Ṛṣis, by Śaṃkarācārya), Cat.
सं-यमिनी f. N. of the city Kāśī, KāśīKh.
N. of Yama's residence (also written सं-यमनी, q.v.), Śaṃk.
संयमिनी-पति m. N. of Yama, KāśīKh.
सं-यम्य mfn. to be checked or restrained or subdued, Car.
सं-√ यस् cl. 4. 1. P. -यस्यति, -यसति, to make effort &c., Pāṇ. iii, 1, 72.
स॑न्यस् mfn. = स॑नीयस्, RV.
सं-यास॑ m. making effort, exertion, VS.
सं-न्यास m. (ifc. f(आ). ) putting or throwing down, laying aside, resignation, abandonment of (gen. or comp.), MBh.; R.; Sarvad.
renunciation of the world, profession of asceticism, Mn.; MBh. &c.
abstinence from food, L.
giving up the body, sudden death, W.
complete exhaustion, Suśr.
deposit, trust, R.; Mṛcch.
contract, agreement, Kathās.
stake, wager, MBh.
Indian spikenard, L.
सं-˚यात्रा f. travelling together (esp. by sea), L.
सं-˚यात्रिक w.r. for सां-यात्रिक.
सांयात्रिक m. (fr. सं-यात्रा) a voyaging merchant, one who trades by sea &c., Hariv.; Kāv.; Kathās.
सांयात्रिक n. any vehicle, L.
the morning dawn, L.
सं-यान m. a mould, L.
सं-यान (अम्), n. going together, going along with (comp.), Kathās.
going, travelling a journey (with उत्तम, ‘the last j˚’, i.e. the carrying out of a dead body), MBh.; R.; Hariv.
setting out, departure, MBh.
a vehicle, waggon, car &c., R.; Mṛcch.
N. of partic. Sūktas, TS.
सं-या॑नी (˚या॑नी), f. N. of partic. bricks, Kāṭh.; ŚBr.
सं-√ याच् Ā. -याचते, to ask, beg, implore, solicit, MBh.; BhP.
सं-यवन n. mixing, mingling, Jaim.; VS., Sch.
a square of four houses (= or w.r. for संजवन), MW.
सं-˚याव m. a sort of cake (of wheaten flour fried with ghee and milk and made up into an oblong form with sugar and spices), Mn.; MBh. &c.
सं॑-युत mfn. joined or bound together, tied, fettered, R.; Ragh.
put together, joined or connected with (instr. with and without सह, or comp.), AV. &c. &c.
increased by, added to (instr. or comp.), VarBṛS.; Rājat.
(ifc.) being in conjunction with, VarBṛS.
consisting of, containing (instr. or comp.), R.
(ifc.) relating to, implying (प्रैष्य-स्˚, ‘implying service’), Mn. ii, 32
accumulated (v.l. for सम्-भृत), Śak. iv, 120/121
सं-˚युति f. the total of two numbers or quantities, Bījag.
the conjunction of planets, Gaṇit.
सं-युयूषु mfn. (fr. Desid.) wishing to join together, wishing to unite with (instr.), Bhaṭṭ.
सं-युज् mfn. joined together, united, connected, related, MBh.; BhP.
सं-युज् m. a relation, Śiś.
सं-युज् f. union, connection (= सं-योग), BhP., Sch.
सं॑-युक्त mfn. conjoined, joined together, combined, united (pl., ‘all together’), TS. &c. &c.
conjunct (as consonants), Pāṇ. vi, 3, 59, Sch.
connected, related (= सम्बन्धिन्), PārGṛ.
married to (instr.), Mn. ix, 23
placed, put, fixed in (loc.), MBh.
accompanied or attended by, endowed or furnished with, full of (instr. or comp.), Mn.; MBh. &c.
(ifc.) connected with, relating to, concerning, KātyŚr.; MBh. &c.
सं॑-युक्ता (आ), f. a kind of metre, Col.
सं॑-युक्तम् (अम्), ind. jointly, together, at the same time, ŚvetUp.
सं-युक्त—संचय-पिटक m. N. of wk.
सं-युक्त—संयोग m. connection with the connected (e.g. the connection of a trace with a horse), Kaṇ.
सं-युक्त—समवाय m. inherence in the connected (one of the six kinds of perception in Nyāya), Tarkas.
सं-युक्त—समवेत-समवाय m. inherence in that which inheres in the connected, ib.
संयुक्ताक्षर n. a conjunct letter, Prāt.
सं-युक्˚तागम m. N. of a Buddh. Āgama
सं-युक्˚ताभिधर्म-शास्त्र n. N. of a Buddh. wk.
सं-युग n. (in BhP. also m.) union, conjunction, MBh.
conflict, battle, war, MBh.; Kāv. &c. (cf. Naigh. ii, 17)
सांयुग mf(ई)n. (fr. सं-युग) relating to battle (with कु f. ‘a battle-field’), Śiś.
सं-युग—गोष्पद n. a contest in a cow's footstep (met. ‘an insignificant struggle’), MBh.
सं-युग—मूर्धन् m. the van or front of battle, Ragh.

सं-योग m. conjunction, combination, connection (˚गे or ˚गेषु ifc. ‘in connection with, with regard to, concerning’), union or absorption with or in (gen., or instr. with and without सह, or loc., or ifc.), Āpast.; MBh. &c.

contact (esp. in phil. ‘direct material contact’, as of sesamum seed with rice-grains [in contradistinction to contact by the fusion of particles, as of water with milk], enumerated among the 24 Guṇas of the Nyāya cf. under सम्-बन्ध), Yogas.; Kaṇ.; Bhāṣāp.
carnal contact, sexual union, MBh. &c.
matrimonial connection or relationship by marriage with or between (gen., सह with instr., or comp.), Gaut.; Mn.; MBh. &c.
a kind of alliance or peace made between two kings with a common object, Kām.; Hit.
agreement of opinion, consensus (opposed to भेद), R.
applying one's self closely to, being engaged in, undertaking (˚गं √ कृ, ‘to undertake, set about, begin’; अग्निहोत्र-संयोगम् √ कृ, ‘to undertake the maintenance of a sacred fire’), Āpast.; Mn.; R.
(in gram.) a conjunct consonant, combination of two or more consonants, Prāt.; Pāṇ. &c.
dependence of one case upon another, syntax, Vop.
(in astron.) conjunction of two or more heavenly bodies, MW.
total amount, sum, VarBṛS.
N. of Śiva, MBh.
सं-योग—पृथक्-त्व n. (in phil.) separateness with conjunction (a term applied to express the separateness of what is optional from what is a necessary constituent of anything), MW.
सं-योग—मन्त्र m. a nuptial text or formula, Gaut.
सं-योग—विरुद्ध n. food which causes disease through being mixed, MW.
सं-˚योगित mfn. = (or w.r. for) ˚योजित, L.
सं-˚योगिन् mfn. being in contact or connection, closely connected with (instr. or comp.), Kaṇ.; Śaṃk.; MārkP.
united (with a loved object; opp. to विरहिन्), Kāvyād., Sch.
married, W.
conjunct, one of the consonants in a combination of c˚, Pāṇ. i, 2, 27, Sch.
सं-˚यो˚गि-त्व n. close connection, Sarvad.
सं-योजक mfn. joining together, connecting, uniting, MW.
bringing together or about, occasioning (comp.), Gaut.
सं-˚यो॑जन n. the act of joining or uniting with (instr. or loc.), ŚBr. &c. &c.
all that binds to the world, cause of re-birth, Divyāv.
copulation, sexual union, L.
(with मित्रा-वरुणयोः, अश्विनोः, and प्रहितोः) N. of Sāmans, ĀrṣBr.,
सं-˚योजयितव्य mfn. to be joined or united, Kāraṇḍ.
सं-˚योजित mfn. (fr. Caus.) conjoined, attached &c., BhP.
सं-˚योजित—कर-युगल mfn. one who has both his hands joined together, ib.
सं-˚योज्य mfn. to be joined or brought together, to be fixed upon (loc.), MBh.

सं-√ युध् Ā. -युध्यते (rarely P. ˚ति), to fight together, fight with, combat, oppose (instr. with or without सार्धम्), MBh.; R.; BhP. :
Caus. -योधयति, to cause to fight together, bring into collision, RV.;
to fight, encounter, MBh. :
Desid., -युयुत्सति, to wish to fight, be eager for battle, MBh. (cf. next).
सं-युयुत्सु mfn. (fr. Desid.) wishing to fight, eager for battle, Rājat.
सं-योद्धव्य n. (impers.) it is to be fought, MBh.
सं-योद्धृ See प्रति-संय्˚.
सं-योध m. fight, battle
सं-योध—कण्टक m. ‘a thorn in battle’, N. of a Yakṣa, R.
सं-√ युप् Caus. -योपयति, to efface, obliterate, remove, RV.
सं-न्यसन n. throwing down, laying aside, giving up, resignation, renunciation of worldly concerns, Bhag.
सं-न्यस्त mfn. thrown down, laid aside, relinquished, abandoned, deserted, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
encamped, R.
deposited, intrusted, consigned, ib.
सं-न्यस्त—देह mfn. one who has given up his body, MW.
सं-न्यस्त—शस्त्र mfn. one who has laid aside his weapons, Ragh.
सं-न्यास—कर्म-कारिका f. N. of wk.
सं-न्यास—ग्रहण n. assuming or practising asceticism, Pañcar.
सं-न्यास—ग्रहण-पद्धति f. N. of wk.
सं-न्यास—ग्रहण-रत्नमाला f. N. of wk.
सं-न्यास—ग्राह्य-पद्धति f. N. of wk.
सं-न्यास—दीपिका f. N. of wk.
सं-न्यास—धर्म-संग्रह m. N. of wk.
सं-न्यास—निर्णय m. N. of wk.
सं-न्यास—पद-मञ्जरी f. N. of wk.
सं-न्यास—पद्धति f. N. of wk.
सं-न्यास—पल्ली f. (for ˚सि-प्˚?) an ascetic's hut, L.
सं-न्यास—भेद-निर्णय m. N. of wk.
सं-न्यास—रीति f. N. of wk.
सं-न्यास—वत् mfn. connected with asceticism, L.
सं-न्यास—विधि m.
सं-न्या˚साश्रम-विचार m. N. of wk.
सं-न्या˚साह्निक n. N. of wk.
सं-न्या˚सोपनिषद् f. N. of wk.
सं-˚न्यासिक in वेद-स्˚ (q.v.)
सांन्यासिक mfn. (fr. सं-न्यास) forming the original or correct text, Pat. on iii, 2, 107, Vārtt. 2
सांन्यासिक m. a Brāhman in the fourth stage of his life, religious mendicant, L.
सं-न्यासिन् mfn. laying aside, giving up, abandoning, renouncing, AṣṭāvS.
abstaining from food, Bhaṭṭ.

सं-न्यासिन् m. one who abandons or resigns worldly affairs, an ascetic, devotee (who has renounced all earthly concerns and devotes himself, to meditation and the study of the Āraṇyakas or Upaniṣadas, a Brāhman in the fourth Āśrama [q.v.] or stage of his life, a religious mendicant; cf. RTL. 53, 55 &c.), Up.; MBh.; Pur.
सं-न्या˚सि-ता f. abandonment of worldly concerns, retirement from the world, MW.
सं-न्या˚सि-त्व n. abandonment of worldly concerns, retirement from the world, MW.
सं-न्यासि-दर्शन n. N. of a ch. of the PadmaP.
सं-न्यासि—संध्या f. N. of wk.
सं-न्यासि—समाराधन n. N. of wk.
सं-न्युप्त mfn. (fr. सं-नि-√ वप्) thrown together.
सांयमनि॑क mfn. = संयमन, Mahāvy.
सांयातिक mf(आ and ई)n. (fr. prec.), ib.
सांयुगीन mfn. relating to war or battle, warlike, martial, Kālid.
सांयुगीन m. a hero, great warrior, ib.
सांयोगिक mfn. = संयोगाय प्रभवति, g. संतापादि.
सांयौगिक mfn. related, being in relation, connected, Nir. i, 2.
सान्य-पुत्र m. N. of a teacher, Cat.
